lines.en: I come down step by step on the stone.
Grit rolls away under my feet.
I walk slowly, but heavily.
I shift forward along the ridge.
I crush the rubble underfoot.
My body is like a heap of stone.
I raise my head to find the way.
I go around a deep fissure.
My arms hang at my sides.
The stones grind against each other.
I head toward where the ore is.
I paused once, then went on.
The ground takes my weight.
I turn my body slowly about.
I stand still on the slope.
I'm sniffing at the stone.
The stones of my body creak.
I start gnawing an ore chunk.
I lift a hand and examine it.
Wind blows sand into my joints.
Grit falls off me when I move.
I'm counting the rocks in my body.
I hear an echo in the hill.
I crouch down slowly.
I bury my feet in the rubble.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，慢慢啃一块岩。
lines.en: I crouch and slowly gnaw a rock.
There's plenty of stone here.

lines.zh: 石块摩擦，发出很低的声音。
lines.en: Stones grind, making a low sound.
You're standing right in front of me.
I hang my head low over you.
You don't look like stone at all.
I can't smell what use you are.
Only three steps lie between us.
The scent of you is quite strange.
I raise my arm slowly.
You took half a step backwards.
My palm is bigger than your head.
Do you eat ore as well?
I watch you without moving.

lines.zh: 你在我眼里，轻得像片叶。
lines.en: To me you are light as a leaf.
I tilt my head and consider.
You may stand there.
Speak, and I will hear you out.
Your voice is rather small.
Some rocks fell off me.
That shook me off balance.
One of my joints seized up.
I steadied my feet slowly.
My stones have come loose.
I shifted back half a step.
That damage doesn't count as a wound.
I look down at the crack.
I press the stones tight again.
The stone is cracked; I have not come apart.
Is there ore in that?
One sniff — it's the real thing.
I shuffle toward your side.
That's not quite enough.
You're holding up a stone.
I stretch my arm out to take it.
It's harder than it looks.
I tried one bite of it.
This one tastes all right.
This ore is gone in one mouthful.
How many more ores are in your pocket.
Keep your hand out a moment longer.

lines.zh: 你撞上石头，自己被弹回来。
lines.en: You hit stone and bounce back yourself.

lines.zh: 我的脚在原地没挪半分。
lines.en: My feet have not shifted a fraction.
The rocks in me loosened.

lines.zh: 石头撞石头，只闷响一声。
lines.en: Stone meets stone with one dull thud.
The impact pushed you back two paces.
I slowly adjusted my stance.
The rubble crunched under me.
All of you reaches only my knee.

lines.zh: 我这几吨石头，你推不动。
lines.en: You cannot push a few tons of stone.
We each stepped back half a pace.
I'm made of stone.
I don't understand this sort of thing.
Digging side by side is fine.

lines.zh: 你身上那块矿，成色不错。
lines.en: That ore on you is good quality.
Let's guard this mine together.
Our footfalls carry the same weight.
I'll watch the other side for you.
Under the rock is safe enough.
I'm slow; don't wait for me.
This is already quite enough.

lines.zh: 我顺手拾起脚边的石块。
lines.en: I pick up a stone by my feet.
This ore is edible.

lines.zh: 我嚼了两下，石头就没了。
lines.en: Two chews and the stone is gone.
Your thing came down by my feet.
It broke apart in my palm.

lines.zh: 我把它在掌心翻了个面。
lines.en: I turn it over in my palm.
Not even one mouthful for me.

lines.zh: 我放它回到原来的地方。
lines.en: I put it back where it belonged.
It isn't ore at all.
I fling it to one side.
You've walked into my ground.

lines.zh: 我整个转过来，石头在响。
lines.en: I turn fully, my stones grating.
I set off walking toward you.
My footfalls land with a dull thud.
You've backed to the rock face.
There's no other way there either.

lines.zh: 我的手举起来，挡住半边天。
lines.en: My hand rises and blocks half the sky.
I pin down your bearing.
You can't outrun the rocks I throw.
Only two strides remain.

lines.zh: 我每落一脚，山都应一声。
lines.en: Each step I take, the hill answers.
It's about to begin.
I press forward inch by inch.
You've hidden behind a boulder.
I can shift that boulder.
I slowly eat up this stretch.
You're crunching the rubble.

lines.zh: 你的脚声逃不过我耳朵。
lines.en: Your steps don't escape my ears.
I lift a stone in my hand.
I'm about to throw it.
You've run up the slope.
Climbing is slow for you.

lines.zh: 你和我之间的距离在变短。
lines.en: The gap between us is shrinking.
It's time to act now.
My fist comes down.
You're driven into the rubble.

lines.zh: 我把全身的分量压上去。
lines.en: I put my whole weight behind it.
I picked you up and threw you down.

lines.zh: 你的护甲被砸塌一大片。
lines.en: Your armor collapsed across a wide area.

lines.zh: 这一拳陷下去半个人深。
lines.en: This fist sinks half a body deep.
You rolled to the rock face.
I raised my other hand.

lines.zh: 这一拳，我只出了半分力。
lines.en: I put only half a measure of strength into that.
Can you get up?
I lower my arm slowly.
Enough — stop right there.
I rise out of the rubble.

lines.zh: 身上的石块一块块归位。
lines.en: The stones of my body settle into place.
There are many hills here.
I begin searching for ore.
The stones crumble under my feet.
I raise my head and sniff the air.
I hear a noise in the hills.

lines.zh: 我朝着矿脉的方向迈一步。
lines.en: I take one step toward the ore vein.
My joints clack loudly.
I stretch my arms out.
There's another scent nearby.
I slowly turn my body aside.
Wind blows dust into me.
My condition is ready.
Fire has my stone face searing.
I fell and the ground split.
Water gets in through my seams.

lines.zh: 火药的力只让我歪了半步。
lines.en: The blast only tips me half a pace.
An arrow bounced off the stone.
That force loosened me up.
I haven't eaten ore in a while.
Lightning burst against my shell.
No ground beneath; I'm falling.
